summary: Added module-level cube(n: int) -> int to src/app_int/main.py, with a docstring, returning n * n * n (C-1, C-2). health_check() and add() are unchanged (C-4), and no dependencies or refactors were added (C-7). Checks run locally: an ad-hoc `uv run python -c` script confirmed cube(3)==27, cube(2)==8, cube(0)==0, cube(1)==1, cube(-2)==-8, cube(-3)==-27, add(2,3)==5 and health_check()=={'status': 'ok'}. `uv run pytest -q` passed (2 existing tests) and `uv run ruff check .` passed (C-5, C-6). NOTE ON C-3: this role may only write under src/**, and tests/ is owned by QA, so no test was added to tests/test_main.py. QA should add a test there that imports cube from app_int.main and asserts the six examples above, which the design maps to AC-2 through AC-5.
